findings.text: Both status matches use catch-all branches, so a new `ProofCostStatus` constructor would silently receive an existing classification. Fix: name every status constructor explicitly and handle missing counts separately.
The catch-all status branch would print any new `ProofCostStatus` constructor as “not exact” without requiring an implementation decision. Fix: enumerate all status constructors explicitly.

Tests omit unusable baseline records, allowing an inexact baseline entry whose current record failed or disappeared to produce exit 0 despite the required failure. Fix: check current failure and absence independently of baseline count availability, and add regression guards for both cases.
The new `compare'` function has no docstring explaining its purpose. Fix: document that it compares test libraries against the shared baseline.
The new entry records Part 2 work, but the opening still identifies Part 1 as current despite its recorded completion. Fix: update the opening to identify Part 2 as the current work.
